title: Printing of tin perovskite solar cells via controlled crystallization
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2063-2071
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01321B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xuan Li, Giuseppe Nasti, Chris Dreessen, Janardan Dagar, Rico Meitzner, Davide Amoroso, Pier Luca Maffettone, Thomas Kirchartz, Eva Unger, Antonio Abate, Stoichko D. Dimitrov
A new method and additive for printing tin-based perovskite films were developed, which enabled printing the first slot-die-coated tin perovskite device. This advancement paves the way for scalable, fully printed lead-free perovskite photovoltaics.
